attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Texas franchise tax return. Checks for physical presence, economic nexus, or Texas registration. No tax due threshold: $1.23M in total revenue.

condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_physical_presence true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "TX" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets Texas economic nexus threshold ($500K Texas receipts)
condition_details.condition_postfix: apportionment.has_economic_nexus true beq { pop apportionment.state_code "TX" streq } over if

condition_details.condition_comment: Total revenue below $1.23M no-tax-due threshold; result.tx_total_revenue < result.tx_no_tax_due_threshold

action_details.action_comment: Physical presence but below threshold - no tax due; No tax due - total revenue below $1.23M threshold
action_details.action_postfix: true /result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due xdef 0.0 /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef "TX franchise tax: No tax due (revenue below $1.23M threshold). Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(d)(2)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Physical nexus established - franchise tax calculation required
action_details.action_dsl: TX franchise tax filing required due to physical presence
action_details.action_postfix: false /result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due xdef "TX franchise tax filing required due to physical presence. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.001" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Economic nexus established - franchise tax calculation required; TX franchise tax filing required due to economic nexus ($500K threshold)
action_details.action_postfix: false /result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due xdef "TX franchise tax filing required due to economic nexus ($500K TX receipts). Reference: TX Tax Code 171.0001(a)(1)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No nexus - no filing required; No Texas nexus - no filing requirement
action_details.action_postfix: true /result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due xdef 0.0 /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TX nexus - no filing required. Any estimated payments would be refunded." job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine which deduction method produces the lowest franchise tax liability. Taxpayer can choose COGS, compensation, or 70% of revenue.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above no-tax-due threshold; result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due == false

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below threshold - deduction method not applicable; No franchise tax due - deduction method not applicable
action_details.action_postfix: "none" /result.tx_deduction_method xdef 0.0 /result.tx_margin_deduction xdef "No TX franchise tax due - deduction method not applicable." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Use 70% of revenue deduction; 70% of revenue provides largest deduction (simplified method)
action_details.action_postfix: "70_percent" /result.tx_deduction_method xdef result.tx_total_revenue get 0.70 mul /result.tx_margin_deduction xdef "TX franchise tax: Using 70% of revenue deduction method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1012(f)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: COGS provides larger deduction than compensation
action_details.action_postfix: "cogs" /result.tx_deduction_method xdef result.tx_cogs get /result.tx_margin_deduction xdef "TX franchise tax: Using COGS deduction method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1012(i)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_dsl: Compensation provides larger deduction than COGS
action_details.action_postfix: "compensation" /result.tx_deduction_method xdef result.tx_compensation get /result.tx_margin_deduction xdef "TX franchise tax: Using compensation deduction method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1012(f)" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Texas taxable margin for franchise tax. Margin = Revenue - (COGS or Compensation or 70% of Revenue)

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above no-tax-due threshold; result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due == false
Qualifies for E-Z computation ($20M or less in revenue)

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below threshold - no margin calculation; No franchise tax due - margin calculation not applicable
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.tx_taxable_margin xdef 0.0 /result.tx_apportioned_margin xdef "No TX franchise tax due - margin calculation not applicable." job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: E-Z Computation option available; Calculate margin - E-Z computation available ($20M or less)
action_details.action_postfix: true /result.tx_qualifies_for_ez_computation xdef result.tx_total_revenue get result.tx_margin_deduction get sub 0.0 max /result.tx_taxable_margin xdef result.tx_taxable_margin get apportionment.apportionment_factor get mul /result.tx_apportioned_margin xdef "TX margin calculated. E-Z computation available. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1016" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Standard margin calculation (no E-Z); Calculate margin - standard method (revenue exceeds $20M)
action_details.action_postfix: false /result.tx_qualifies_for_ez_computation xdef result.tx_total_revenue get result.tx_margin_deduction get sub 0.0 max /result.tx_taxable_margin xdef result.tx_taxable_margin get apportionment.apportionment_factor get mul /result.tx_apportioned_margin xdef "TX margin calculated using standard method. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.101" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Texas franchise tax liability. Applies 0.75% or 0.375% rate to apportioned margin. IMPORTANT: This is NOT an income tax.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has nexus and above no-tax-due threshold; result.tx_qualifies_for_no_tax_due == false
Elects to use E-Z computation method; result.tx_qualifies_for_ez_computation == true
Primarily engaged in retail or wholesale trade

action_details.action_comment: No nexus or below threshold - no franchise tax; No Texas franchise tax due
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TX franchise tax due. Any estimated payments will be refunded. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(d)(2)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: E-Z Computation (simplified method); TX franchise tax using E-Z computation (0.575%)
action_details.action_postfix: result.tx_total_revenue get result.tx_no_tax_due_threshold get sub 0.0 max /taxable_revenue xdef taxable_revenue get result.tx_ez_computation_rate get mul apportionment.apportionment_factor get mul /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef result.tx_franchise_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef result.tx_franchise_tax get /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "TX franchise tax: E-Z computation. (Revenue - $1.23M) × 0.575%. NOT an income tax. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.1016" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Retail/wholesale reduced rate (0.375%); TX franchise tax at reduced retail/wholesale rate
action_details.action_postfix: 0.00375 /result.tx_margin_tax_rate xdef result.tx_apportioned_margin get result.tx_margin_tax_rate get mul /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef result.tx_franchise_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef result.tx_franchise_tax get /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "TX franchise tax: Retail/wholesale rate 0.375%. NOT an income tax. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(b)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: Standard rate (0.75%); TX franchise tax at standard rate
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0075 /result.tx_margin_tax_rate xdef result.tx_apportioned_margin get result.tx_margin_tax_rate get mul /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef result.tx_franchise_tax get apportionment.state_credits get sub 0.0 max /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef result.tx_franchise_tax get /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get apportionment.state_tax get sub /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "TX franchise tax: Standard rate 0.75%. NOT an income tax. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.002(a)" job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No apportioned margin - no franchise tax; No TX franchise tax due - zero or negative margin
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.tx_franchise_tax xdef 0.0 /apportionment.state_tax xdef apportionment.state_payments get /apportionment.state_refund_or_owed xdef "No TX franchise tax due - zero or negative margin. No loss carryforward. Reference: TX Tax Code 171.101" job.audit_trail swap addto
